profile.name: Adheesh Kale
profile.headline: Computer science student building tools at the edge of data and design

experiences.title: B.S. Computer Science
experiences.summary: Coursework concentrated in systems, machine learning, and human-computer interaction, with a minor emphasis on quantitative biology.
responsibilities: Coursework: Data Structures, Machine Learning, Database Systems, Human-Computer Interaction
Teaching assistant for the introductory programming sequence

experiences.title: Certificate in Data Journalism
responsibilities: Built and published three interactive data stories from public datasets
Studied statistical literacy and the ethics of visual persuasion

experiences.title: Software Engineering Intern
experiences.summary: Worked on the customer-facing reporting product, focused on making large result sets fast to read and possible to act on.
responsibilities: Rebuilt the report builder's filter layer, cutting median query time from 4.1s to 380ms
Added keyboard navigation and screen-reader labelling across the dashboard, closing 23 open accessibility issues
Wrote the internal guide to the charting library, now the team's onboarding reference

gallery.alt: The rebuilt report builder showing a filter panel on the left and a results table on the right
gallery.caption: The rebuilt filter layer

gallery.alt: Line chart showing median query latency dropping from four seconds to under half a second over eight weeks
gallery.caption: Median query latency across the internship

experiences.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
experiences.summary: Supported a lab studying how people interpret uncertainty in model output, contributing both to the experiment tooling and the analysis.
responsibilities: Built the stimulus-generation pipeline used across four studies
Ran analysis on 1,200 participant responses and produced the figures for the resulting paper
Co-authored the methods section

gallery.alt: Diagram of the stimulus generation pipeline, with four stages feeding into a participant-facing survey
gallery.caption: Pipeline architecture

experiences.title: Shift Lead
responsibilities: Trained six new baristas and wrote the opening checklist still in use
Handled scheduling for a team of eleven across two locations

experiences.title: Atlas — a map of what you have read
experiences.summary: A personal reading tracker that lays your library out as a citation graph rather than a list, so the shape of what you have read is visible at a glance.
responsibilities: Designed and built the force-directed graph view in TypeScript and D3
Shipped a keyboard-only navigation mode after usability testing showed the graph was unusable without a mouse
Currently used by roughly 400 people

gallery.caption: Keyboard navigation mode

gallery.caption: Early wireframe, before the graph

experiences.title: Tidewater — a tide clock for the terminal
experiences.summary: A small command-line tool that renders the next twelve hours of tide for any NOAA station as a sparkline.
responsibilities: Wrote the NOAA client and the Unicode sparkline renderer in Python
Packaged for Homebrew and PyPI

gallery.alt: Terminal window showing a twelve-hour tide sparkline for a NOAA station
gallery.caption: Tidewater running in a terminal

experiences.title: Quorum — consensus tooling for student orgs
responsibilities: Interviewed eleven club officers to find where decisions actually stall
Designed the proposal-and-vote flow in Figma and shipped it as a React app
Adopted by nine student organisations in the first semester

experiences.title: Data Engineering Intern
experiences.summary: Built the ingestion layer for a telemetry product.
responsibilities: Wrote the Kafka consumer that backfills historical partitions
Cut the nightly batch window from six hours to ninety minutes
